name: By-health Co., Ltd.
summary: By-health Co., Ltd. operates internationally as a producer and vendor of a diverse range of dietary supplements. Its comprehensive portfolio encompasses essential nutrients like proteins, vitamins, and minerals, in addition to specialized solutions addressing numerous health needs. These include offerings for supporting bone and joint integrity, promoting cardiovascular and brain health, enhancing beauty, boosting immunity, assisting with weight control, improving vigor, nourishing eyes, aiding sleep, managing blood sugar, optimizing memory, and supporting reproductive wellness. The company also provides tailored nutrition for children, expectant mothers, and the well-being of the liver, digestive tract, and stomach. Sold under the "By-health" and "GymMax" labels, these products are designed for all age groups—children, adult men and women, and seniors—and are distributed globally through a multi-channel approach involving wholesale partners, retail stores, and online platforms. Established in 1995, By-health Co., Ltd. is based in Guangzhou, China. The firm was previously known as Guangdong By-Health Biotechnology Co., Ltd. until its rebranding in April 2012.
